paragraphs: Kofile sells preservation, digitization, and modern access services for government records. The product range covers archival binders, archival boxes and folders, plat cabinets, and shelving systems for original records. Kleio is described as an AI-enhanced document intelligence platform that connects preserved records with secure access for agencies.

The about page states that Kofile works exclusively with government agencies on permanent public records. The home page describes working with state and local governments to preserve records and make them easy to find. Groups named on the home page include town administrators and city managers.

Kofile traces its archival binding back to 1878 and describes a history that joins preservation craftsmanship with cloud and AI work. Delivery is described through transparent scopes, timelines, and pricing, with chain-of-custody controls and quality assurance.

quote.text: Kofile works exclusively with government agencies, delivering decades of experience preserving and modernizing permanent public records.
